author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a taller adult with the head centred over a vertical torso holds hands with a smaller, lower child whose arm reaches diagonally left and whose legs are bent; a pointed pine tree with a short trunk stands at the upper right. This follows all three review points. Human spacing: the adult head r4 at (10,12) is exactly 8 above the neck (10,24), and the child head r3 at (25,15) is exactly 8 above the neck (25,26); both are vertical and certified.
omissions: The child's second arm is dropped (with bent legs and a 7-unit torso it cannot keep 8 units of clearance), and the pine is a single triangle rather than a tiered crown. An r2 child head (attempts/v2-r2-child-head.svg) rendered as a filled dot.
